title: Sparse-Table Argmin
statement:
Use a sparse table to answer static queries for the minimum value and its leftmost position.

Input
n q, then n signed values, then q inclusive 1-based ranges L R.

Output
For each query print minimum value and its leftmost index in the range.

Constraints
1 ≤ n ≤ 200000. Array values have absolute value at most 10⁹. 1 ≤ q ≤ 200000.
